Name: Extremely Small Ocean Farm
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

Are you looking for a challenge? Do you like extremely small things? Do you think you can achieve perfection by testing your limits? If the answer is yes, then this map is for you.

Extremely Small Ocean Farm is a cute farm overlooking the ocean, with a small stream running through it, it replaces the river farm, everything is diggable, on the beach you have both fodder and supply crates and also the farm It has blue grass,  features ocean fish in the ocean and river fish in the river; the same applies to crab pots.

Have fun!

[color=#00ffff][size=5]Thank you for your support! <3[/size][/color]
